fieldDescription: How the submarket buttons above the cargo and fleet screens are laid out. Stretched: the vanilla number of buttons per row widened to fill the row. Five per row (default): five buttons with names in each row; names too long for the button are cut short. Unfold on hover: icon sized buttons with one button opened to show its name; the button under the cursor opens and the open one folds while the row keeps its width. The last hovered button stays open after the cursor leaves. The storage button always sits at the right end of the last row. Changes apply the next time the screen opens.
How many seconds Unfold on hover takes to open a button fully (default 0.1). 0 opens it at once. Changes apply the next time the screen opens.

Animates the outline around the selected submarket button with four highlights in the submarket's color running clockwise. Off (default): a still outline. Black band: the outline becomes a soft black band with the highlights on it. Changes apply the next time the screen opens.
